def greedy(w,k=6):
    chosen=['one']
    base=[np.ones_like(t),np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t)]
    keys=list(lib.keys())
    out=[]
    for step in range(k):
        best=None
        for kk in keys:
            if kk in chosen: continue
            G=np.column_stack(base+[lib[c] for c in chosen if c!='one']+[lib[kk]])
            cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(G,dv_dt,rcond=None)
            n=np.mean((dv_dt-G@cc)**2)/np.var(dv_dt)
            if best is None or n<best[0]: best=(n,kk,cc)
        chosen.append(best[1]); out.append((round(best[0],7),best[1]))
    return out
